name: Environmental Chemistry
summary: Chemical processes in water, soil and air, and the sources, fate and effects of pollutants.

topics.name: Environmental compartments and biogeochemical cycles (C, N, S, P)
Natural water chemistry: hardness and alkalinity
Water pollution: nutrients, heavy metals, organics and pathogens
Soil chemistry: minerals, organic matter and ion exchange
Persistent organic pollutants, pesticides and PFAS
Environmental fate and transport: partitioning (Kow, Henry's law) and degradation
Toxic metals: speciation of mercury, lead, arsenic and cadmium
Energy, climate and the chemistry of the carbon cycle
Chemical regulation and environmental risk (REACH, TSCA)
